notes: `לִמְעוֹל מַעַל` is read as one fused rendering *trespassed* under rule 30 rather than leaving the cognate accusative `unrepresented`; the competing reading gives *trespassed* to the infinitive alone and marks `מַעַל` unrendered under rule 22.
`הִרְבּוּ` carries the adverbial *very greatly* as one rendering, headed on *greatly*, which is the word carrying the lexeme; *very* is not `added`.
Neither `כֹּל` takes an *of*: the ASV writes *all the abominations* with no relational word, so the quantifier keeps only its own word (rule 19).
